
# ENTERPRISE SLA & POLICY HANDBOOK (TECHSTORE GLOBAL)

## SECTION 1: GLOBAL WARRANTY PROTOCOL (TIER 1-4)
- All TechStore flagship electronics are backed by our 2-Year Ultimate Manufacturer Guarantee.
- Accidental Damage Protection (ADP) covers up to 2 catastrophic liquid spills and 3 screen replacements per 12-month billing period with zero deductible for Platinum members.
- Defective units are eligible for Advance Hardware Replacement (AHR) with priority overnight shipping at no cost.
- Serial number verification is instantaneous through the TechStore Mobile Portal without requiring original paper receipts.

## SECTION 2: ENTERPRISE RETURN & REFUND POLICY
- Standard consumer items have a 45-day zero-friction return window.
- Commercial volume orders (> 50 units) have a 60-day trial period with complimentary pallet return pickup.
- Open-box products are inspected across a 72-point hardware test and re-certified with full warranty backing.
- Instant refunds are issued to the original payment method within 120 minutes of return shipment carrier scan.

## SECTION 3: INTERNATIONAL LOGISTICS & TARIFF COVERAGE
- TechStore operates regional fulfillment centers in North America (Ohio, California), Europe (Frankfurt, Amsterdam), and APAC (Singapore, Tokyo).
- Express Air Courier delivers within 2 business days across 85 countries with all DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) tariffs pre-cleared.
- Cold-chain temperature-controlled transport is standard for lithium-ion power banks and delicate optical assemblies.


## PRODUCT MANUAL #00001: RoboClean HyperV Vacuum (MODEL SKU: TS-ROBOTICS_CLEAN-0001)
Category: ROBOTICS_CLEAN
Overview: Autonomous lidar navigation vacuum with 8000Pa suction, self-emptying base station, and AI obstacle avoidance.

### Technical Specifications:
- Firmware Architecture: V5.1.1 Embedded RTOS with SHA-256 secure boot validation.
- Thermal Operating Range: -20°C to 65°C continuous operation under military MIL-STD-810H vibration standards.
- Ingress Protection: IP68 waterproof and dustproof rated to 5 meters immersion for 2 hours.
- Power Consumption: Standby power < 0.05W, peak active load 101W.

### Diagnostic & Troubleshooting Protocol:
1. Error Code E-007: Communication timeout between primary DSP and sensor cluster. Solution: Hold the multi-function power button for 12 seconds to initiate cold hardware factory reset.
2. Error Code E-013: Thermal throttling triggered at internal junction temperature > 85°C. Solution: Inspect air intake vents, ensure 50mm clearance from obstacles.
3. Calibration: Connect via USB-C to the Diagnostic Studio and run automated 3-point sensor zeroing.

### Support & Replacement Terms:
All parts for SKU TS-ROBOTICS_CLEAN-0001 are stocked in regional hubs with a 7-year guaranteed parts availability lifecycle.

2. Error Code E-923: Thermal throttling triggered at internal junction temperature > 85°C. Solution: Inspect air intake vents, ensure 50mm clearance from obstacles.
3. Calibration: Connect via USB-C to the Diagnostic Studio and run automated 3-point sensor zeroing.

Overview: 3000Wh LiFePO4 portable battery station with 2400W pure sine wave inverter and 800W solar MPPT input.

### Technical Specifications:
- Firmware Architecture: V5.19.9 Embedded RTOS with SHA-256 secure boot validation.
- Thermal Operating Range: -20°C to 65°C continuous operation under military MIL-STD-810H vibration standards.
- Ingress Protection: IP68 waterproof and dustproof rated to 5 meters immersion for 2 hours.
- Power Consumption: Standby power < 0.05W, peak active load 379W.

### Diagnostic & Troubleshooting Protocol:
1. Error Code E-180: Communication timeout between primary DSP and sensor cluster. Solution: Hold the multi-function power button for 12 seconds to initiate cold hardware factory reset.
2. Error Code E-477: Thermal throttling triggered at internal junction temperature > 85°C. Solution: Inspect air intake vents, ensure 50mm clearance from obstacles.
3. Calibration: Connect via USB-C to the Diagnostic Studio and run automated 3-point sensor zeroing.

### Support & Replacement Terms:
All parts for SKU TS-POWER_SYSTEMS-3879 are stocked in regional hubs with a 7-year guaranteed parts availability lifecycle.
